content.title: Aubrey Plaza makes huge announcement on unexpected new role
content.text: Aubrey Plaza has reportedly been quietly preparing for her biggest role yet, becoming a mum!The actress is expecting her first child with partner Chris Abbott, with the baby said to be due later this year after keeping the news largely out of the spotlight.According to People, the pregnancy came as a welcome twist following what has been described as an emotional period for Plaza, with those close to the star saying the couple feel incredibly fortunate.Sign up to The Nightly's newsletters.Get the first look at the digital newspaper, curated daily stories and breaking headlines delivered to your inbox.By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.Plaza and Abbott are not strangers to working closely together.The pair previously appeared opposite each other in the Off-Broadway production of Danny and the Deep Blue Sea and later shared the screen in the 2020 psychological drama Black Bear, a film that blurred the lines between performance and reality in ways that now feel oddly fitting.While the news may come as a surprise to fans, Plaza subtly sparked speculation during recent appearances in Paris, where she embraced relaxed silhouettes while attending fashion week.Seated front row at the Loewe show, the actress layered an oversized leather jacket over a knit, paired with ankle boots — a look that leaned heavily into understated cool. She continued the effortless aesthetic at the Lacoste presentation, opting for a loose-fitting orange polo styled with a mini skirt.Aubrey Plaza attends the Loewe Womenswear Fall/Winter 2026-2027 show. Credit: Arnold Jerocki/Getty ImagesAubrey Plaza attends the Lacoste Womenswear Fall/Winter 2026-2027 show as part of Paris Fashion Week. Credit: Marc Piasecki/WireImageThe low-key wardrobe choices now appear to have served a dual purpose: fashion statement and discreet camouflage.Plaza has largely kept her private life out of the spotlight, particularly following the death of her husband, filmmaker Jeff Baena, last year. Those close to the actress say the pregnancy has brought a renewed sense of optimism during a period of significant change.For fans used to Plaza’s famously dry humour and unconventional career choices, the unexpected baby news feels entirely on brand —a quiet reveal rather than a headline-grabbing announcement.While Plaza has not publicly commented on the pregnancy herself, confirmation has reportedly come via representatives, signalling the actor is preparing for a new chapter away from the camera.
